_comment: M4: seed_firmware_sections took the registry lock before checking whether anything was missing, so a no-op re-run that overlapped a panel write could exit install.sh with 1 for a run that had nothing to do. The unlocked pre-read and its early return are what make a no-op re-run never touch the lock at all.

mutations.name: a no-op re-run is decided before the lock is taken, not after
mutations.find:
text, missing = _read_missing(paths)
    if not missing:
        return []

    with ExclusiveLock(paths, path=paths.registry_lock_file).acquire("seed firmware sections"):
